assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: additional directional skateboard animation sprites for TERMINL Mall Rat. Image 1 is the canonical identity of Margin Call Max. Image 2 is the existing motion sprite sheet, a style/outfit reference. Generate a NEW sheet, preserve the exact gritty richly shaded pixel-illustration style, face, messy brown hair, torn dark REKT shirt, purple/yellow shorts, mismatched white and black socks and black slide sandals. Hands empty: no phone, cigar, smoke or carried items.
Canvas 1536 by 2560 portrait, TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. Exactly FIFTEEN full-body sprites in a precise THREE COLUMN by FIVE ROW grid with equal square cells. Each sprite centered in its cell with at least 40 pixels clear gutter, completely isolated and including both feet. No borders, labels, ground, cast shadows or scenery. NO SKATEBOARDS, DECKS OR WHEELS: the game renders the board separately. Feet pose around an imaginary narrow skateboard. Camera elevated approximately 20 degrees. Same anatomical scale and head size throughout all cells; crouching poses naturally occupy less height, never enlarge them to fill the cell.
EVERY ROW has the same view directions: column 1 LEFT SIDE PROFILE, nose/face facing screen LEFT; column 2 straight FRONT view, face and chest toward viewer; column 3 RIGHT SIDE PROFILE, nose/face facing screen RIGHT. No rear views on this sheet.
ROW 1: relaxed skating coast stance, knees slightly bent, both feet planted fore/aft on imaginary board, arms relaxed for balance.
ROW 2: deep landing/crouch compression, bent hips and knees, both soles at same imaginary deck level, hands near knees.
ROW 3: airborne ollie/kickflip tuck, both knees raised clearly toward torso, feet held beneath knees above the imaginary board, arms out for balance.
ROW 4: airborne grab tuck, knees bent, one hand reaching beside the feet to grip an imaginary skateboard edge, the other arm out for balance.
ROW 5: grinding balance stance, knees moderately flexed, both feet planted at one level, both arms extended sideways for balance.
This is a coherent game animation set, not fifteen portraits. Preserve expressive degen face, crisp dark outline, textured shading and outfit details from references. Keep the same body proportions, identity and scale between views. Real alpha transparency, no checkerboard painted into the image.

All empty space must be genuinely transparent alpha, with a crisp clean dark outline around the illustrated person. Preserve intentional red details INSIDE the character, such as the shorts patch, bruises and clothing details. Keep all fifteen poses, their facing direction, exact identity, anatomical proportions, placement, scale, colors, lighting and 3 by 5 grid unchanged. No backdrop, labels or skateboard. Do not redraw or restyle the character; only clean the exterior matte contamination.
